record.inputs: patch-mean z_t (384) + grouped raw action a_t (30) -> patch-mean (z_{t+1} - z_t) (384); frames 0..11; per-level ridge on the train-split episodes of the level, alpha by episode GroupKFold; errors on the test episodes (100 per level)

level_mean_match.overall_mean: equal-weighted mean of the 9 level means (per patch position)

erasers_shared_across_conditions.note: frozen DINOv2 encoder: erasers are fitted once on cached encoder latents; every checkpoint's encoder fingerprint is compared with the cache's at run time

metric_definitions:
(per sample = one transition f -> f+1, f = 0..11; z = visual part of the REAL encoder latent of frame f, z1 = of frame f+1, z_e = z + delta the erased input):
  pred            visual part of predictor(z_e with the untouched action/proprio coordinates)
  total           mean over (P tokens x dz dims) of (pred - z1)^2                                  [metric A, next-latent token MSE]
  motion          mean of ((pred - z_e) - (z1 - z))^2   predicted CHANGE (relative to the input the predictor saw) vs real change Delta z   [metric B]
  persist         mean of (z1 - z)^2                    the Delta z = 0 prediction (persistence baseline)
  copy            mean of (z_e - z1)^2                  copying the erased input
  disp_norm_mean  mean over tokens of |delta|           disp_sq_mean  mean over tokens of |delta|^2     (verification of the norm matching)

leace_scalar.reading: 이 소거에서 검출되지 않음 (크기 정보를 사용하지 않는다는 뜻이 아님: 소거 불완전 가능성, 소거 확인 수치 참고)
leace_scalar.judged: trained predictor, test episodes of the training levels (a060, ind, a160), motion error / persistence error, Delta_use = size increase - mean random increase
